title: Make the hardware profile a value with typed problems

`HardwareProfile` is a static class with one fixed rule set, returning problems as strings, sitting in `Evolution` beside its own mutation and crossover operators, while the Metal limits and Verilog widths are further implicit profiles; chip targets with limits are planned, and would not fit this shape.
We want a `HardwareProfile` value (rule form, and slots for weight range, fan-in, fan-out and longest delay, unset for now) with a check that returns typed problems naming the neuron or synapse, in a `Hardware` namespace with `HardwareCost`.

Its responsibilities are:
* The profile as a record with today's single profile as one instance
* `Problems(network)` returning typed problems
* `HardwareCost` beside it, with `RegisterWidth` renamed to say it is a spike count, and one "most spikes held" calculation in place of three (`PortRecorder`, `SpikeTrace.MostHeld`, `HardwareCost`)
* `ProfileMutation` and `ProfileCrossover` moved to the evolution operators
* Settings, CLI and searches passing a profile value rather than a flag

The profile's behaviour should not change, because parts in `parts-profile/` were found under it.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/HardwareProfile.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/HardwareCost.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Simulation/PortRecorder.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Simulation/SpikeTrace.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Simulation/Metal/GpuNetwork.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Cli/Settings.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Cli/CommandOptions.cs`.

Done when:
- [ ] The profile is a value, its problems are typed, and nothing in `Export` or `Storage` references `Evolution` for it
- [ ] "Most spikes held" has one definition
- [ ] Golden runs unchanged; `dotnet test` green

Read first: RESEARCH.md "Hardware profile and exporters" (The profile)
